name: KTeam App Icon Family V1
stage: design assets exported; not integrated or accepted in native shells

design.basis: Bot V3, three-tuft main mascot, no limbs, 25-degree view
design.optical_small: Front-facing single-color silhouette with transparent eye holes; avoids compressing the multi-layer face into 16px.

platforms.macos_dock: macos/KTeam.icns (recommended); three separate appearance folders with iconsets. These are alternate files, not automatic appearance switching.
platforms.macos_menubar: macos/menubar/KTeamTemplate.png (16px, 72dpi), KTeamTemplate@2x.png (32px, 144dpi). Blink pair supplied as optional frames, not an implemented animation.
platforms.windows: windows/KTeam.ico contains 16,20,24,32,40,48,64,128,256px. windows/tray has green, black, and white ICO variants. Select a suitable variant for the shell theme.
platforms.ios: ios/AppIcon.appiconset contains 1024px opaque default/dark/tinted images. Porcelain is a visual alternative under masters, not registered as an alternate icon in app code.
platforms.android: android/res contains adaptive vector foreground/background, an API33 monochrome layer, plus legacy fallback density images. android/png-preview is preview-only.
platforms.web: favicon.ico, 180px touch icon, 192/512px PWA images and sample web manifest.
platforms.apple_layers: layers/ contains background, shell, mask and eye SVG layers for all appearances. These are source layers for Icon Composer; no compiled .icon or native Liquid Glass effect is claimed.

validation.browser: three style choices switch; zero duplicate IDs; 320px without horizontal overflow; exported 16px and 32px template PNG eye holes have zero alpha

limitations: No actual Dock, menu bar, Windows shell, Android launcher or iPhone acceptance was performed.
Layered Apple source has not been compiled with Icon Composer; Android resources have not been compiled by a native build.
